payload.detail: UPDATE 2026-09-26: the owner-approved timing probe has now run. Do not run it again. If generation dominates, the work is #231 and #100 Phase 2; if first byte dominates, it is delivery and #016. PRIOR DETAIL: owner reported 2026-09-18 15-45 s to something readable on every question. PRs #2849/#2855 fixed only the catalogue read path, not /api/answer. Production is not stale; catalogue latency is fixed. Last figures on file: retrieval ~1 s fast / ~6.7 s hybrid, generation ~19 s (#231); delivery is structurally uncached (layout headers()/cookies(), page connection(), no CDN, sw.js network-only navigations); app declared in Railway Singapore with Supabase in Sydney (145-340 ms round trip), live region unverified.
